description: eu07/maszyna#350, #282: an EU07 on td.scn couples on the run (Shunt -3 3) to a cut standing on the line, 16 coaches with P alone and 8 empty wagons with G and P, 541 m of wagons, and runs it on as a train (Obey_train): a train on G (Cw-1 19.1), so the brakes of the coaches are to be cut out (19.9). The inspector looks at the train as it couples, at 4 km/h, and leaves the cut-outs for the standstill; reinspect_brakes() makes them as the train stands just after. The driver taken off at 38 km/h leaves the brake valve in the emergency position: braked by the locomotive and the 8 wagons alone the train stops at some 0.27 m/s2, over 210 m (with every brake working, 0.57 m/s2 over 99 m).
